name: Pools and Aliases
description: Pool every subscription and API key that serves the same model under its plain model id: new accounts join automatically, model lists drop provider suffixes, optional 'pools only' view. Uses CPA's native aliases; routing stays untouched.
author: ngvoicu

zh-CN.description: 将提供同一模型的所有订阅与 API Key 合并到以模型原生 ID 命名的池中：新账号自动加入，模型列表去掉提供商后缀，可选“仅显示池”视图。使用 CPA 原生别名，不改变路由。
